data.name: Harbiya
data.gender_notes: Harbiya is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The one who gives fruit, fruitful, fertile. The name Harbiya carries the meaning “Fruitful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Harbiya usually hope their child will grow to embody fruitful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Harbiya belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Fruitful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Harbiya total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_arabic.name: حربية
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مؤنث من أصل عربي، بمعنى الحرب أو المعركة
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم مؤنث أصله عربي، مشتق من كلمة 'حرب'، التي تعني الحرب أو المعركة. لا يوجد ذكر مباشر لهذا الاسم في القرآن الكريم، لكنه يحمل دلالة على القوة والشجاعة والجدية. يُعرف باسم 'حرب' في اللغة العربية، وهو اسم شائع في ثقافات عربية مختلفة. في بعض الثقافات، يُنظر إليه على أنه اسم يمنح الفتاة شجاعة وعنفوان.

in_urdu.name: حربیا
in_urdu.meaning: عربی سے ماخوذ ایک لڑکی کا نام، جس کا معنی جنگ یا معرکہ ہے۔
in_urdu.long_meaning: حربیا ایک عربی اصلاً کا لڑکی کا نام ہے جسے حرب (جنگ) کے الفاظ سے اخذ کیا گیا ہے۔ یہ نام قران میں نہیں ملتا لیکن اس کا معنی جنگ یا معرکہ سے منسوب ہے۔ اس کا استعمال اسلامی دنیا میں، خاص طور پر جنوبی ایشیائی مسلم ثقافت میں، ایک پرانے نام کے طور پر کیا جاتا ہے۔ یہ نام بہادر، شجاع اور مضبوطی کی علامت سمجھا جاتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: हरबिया
in_hindi.meaning: एक लड़की का नाम, जिसका अर्थ है युद्ध या युद्धक्षेत्र।
in_hindi.long_meaning: हरबिया एक अरबी मूल का लड़की का नाम है जो 'हर्ब' (युद्ध) शब्द से लिया गया है। यह नाम कुरान में सीधे नहीं आता है, परंतु यह शक्ति, साहस और दृढ़ता का प्रतीक माना जाता है। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में एक पारंपरिक नाम है और इसे अक्सर लड़कियों को दिलाया जाता है जो शक्तिशाली और साहसी हो।

in_pashto.name: هربيه
in_pashto.meaning: د لښځو نوم، چې معنا يې جګه او نبرد دی.
in_pashto.long_meaning: هربيه په پشتو ژبې کې لښځو نوم دی چې معنا يې جګه او نبرد دی. د هغه نوم له عربي ژبه سره اړه وي، چې د «حرب» لفظ له خوا تر سره کېږی. د قرآن کریم کې د نوم د مذكر شکل «حرب» د وړاندازي سره د يوې لړۍ په برخه کې راځي. له همدې سره، د نوم د پرمختګ او دې سره اړيکه له خوا د اړوي ښه کړو، د هېواد په نوم د لوړوونو په نوم دې نوم په غاړه کې دې نوم تر سره کېږی.

in_english.name: Harbiya
in_english.meaning: A feminine name meaning war or battle.
in_english.long_meaning: Harbiya is a feminine Arabic name derived from the root 'harb,' meaning 'war' or 'battle.' While not directly mentioned in the Quran, it carries connotations of strength, courage, and determination. Harbiya is a traditional name in many Islamic cultures, often bestowed upon girls who are perceived as possessing these qualities. In some cultures, it represents a desire for the girl to be bold and fearless.

data.cultural_impact: The name Harbiya holds great significance in Islamic culture due to its meaning symbolizing productivity, fruitfulness, and growth. This name is associated with the concept of continuing to strive for success and progress in life, as the fruit denotes a reward for one's efforts and labors. This can be seen in various aspects of Islamic society, from agricultural production to personal achievement and economic growth.
data.spiritual_significance: Harbiya also carries deep spiritual significance in the Islamic faith, alluding to the notion of continually nurturing one's soul and spiritual growth. This is paralleled by the broader Islamic teachings of sowing seeds of good deeds, watering them through continuous actions, and allowing them to bear fruit in the form of blessings and righteousness. Embracing the name Harbiya reminds us to remain devoted to cultivating our inner selves, as well as contributing positively to the world around us.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Harbiya: Dynamic, steadfast in faith and struggle. The name Harbiya signifies one who is constantly engaged in the path of righteousness with unwavering determination and courage. It is a name that embodies the spirit of striving in the way of Allah, with a heart full of resolve and a soul filled with strength.

historical_references.reference: Harbiya was a major center of Islamic learning in the early Abbasid period, named after the daughter of Harun al-Rashid.
historical_references.context: Harbiya was a suburb of Baghdad and became famous for its mosque, madrasa (school), and library.

historical_references.reference: Harbiya was a significant military and administrative center during the Fatimid Caliphate, named after the mother of al-Mu'izz li-Din Allah.
historical_references.context: Harbiya was located in Egypt and served as the base for the Fatimid army and the seat of the vizierate.
